title: Soul Feast #27 – Choice, Karma, and The Law of Attraction
excerpt: Have you ever wondered why certain people or situations seem to consistently appear in your life?
bodyHtml:
Have you ever wondered why certain people or situations seem to consistently appear in your life? In this insightful Soul Feast, Gary Zukav dives deep into the powerful principles of choice, karma, and the law of attraction. 

Gary explains that the Law of Attraction—”like energy attracts like energy”—reflects our internal state back to us. 

Whether we cultivate love or fear within, we draw similar energies from the outside world.

At the core of this conversation is the understanding of karma as the direct result of our choices. Gary clarifies common misconceptions, illustrating that while our internal states like judgment or anger do not create karma directly, our actions do. 

It is only when our internal energy translates into actions or words that karma comes into play, impacting both ourselves and others. 

Recognizing and confronting our fearful emotions is essential for shifting towards authentic power.

The pathway to transforming your experiences lies in emotional awareness and consciously choosing love over fear, thus creating authentic power and positively influencing your karmic journey.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

  • (00:00) — The Law of Attraction: How your internal energy attracts similar energies
  • (04:32) — Common misconceptions about karma and how it’s created
  • (09:15) — The critical role actions play in shaping your karmic experiences
  • (14:50) — How emotional awareness helps move you from fear to authentic power
  • (20:05) — Practical ways to recognize and shift fearful emotions toward love

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge: Reflect on moments when you experienced negative emotions or thoughts toward others. Ask yourself: How did your energy affect your interactions and relationships? Now, recall times you chose loving actions or words, even when feeling judgmental. Notice the differences in outcomes and energies you attracted. This week, consciously observe your internal landscape and practice shifting from fear to love.
